findings.short_summary: Retry message loses the original error
findings.summary: The retry log line interpolates the original exception before it has been stringified, so circular payloads are dropped silently.
findings.failure_scenario: A provider transient error with a circular detail object causes the retry emitter to throw, aborting the review instead of retrying.

findings.short_summary: Verbose block prints raw finding objects
findings.summary: The verbose formatter prints the internal finding object directly, including the artifactRefs array that may contain local paths.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator reading the verbose log may see absolute local paths from a CI runner leaked into the review artifact.

findings.short_summary: Blocker dismissal test lacks a negative case
findings.summary: The existing dismissal parser test only asserts that a justified dismissal is kept; it does not assert that an unjustified dismissal is rejected.
findings.failure_scenario: A regression that always accepts dismissals would not be caught, allowing blockers to be waved through without justification.
